summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate) without running any code or tests, as instructed. Changes: added Update(prologue, algebra) container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update, building the prologue from the first declaration group before the empty-request early exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the spec's test list. Choices to review: for non-empty requests the first declaration group is translated twice (idempotent) to build the prologue before the early exit; test_dawg.py's debug-only pprintAlgebra call now receives an Update. Not verified: test suites (including the DAWG and prepareQuery tests) and black formatting have not been run.
